fields.participant_id: Stable anonymous id such as P001.
fields.started_at: ISO-8601 timestamp when participant begins reading.
fields.ended_at: ISO-8601 timestamp when participant submits final answer.
fields.time_to_actionable_review_seconds: Elapsed seconds from start to final answer.
fields.completed: true if participant submitted final answer.
fields.localization_correct: true if answer identifies expected issue location.
fields.recommendation_actionable: true if answer provides implementable fix or diagnostic step.
